reply: For information about the University of Sargodha fee structure, semester dues, and fee challan, please check the official UOS website or contact the relevant department. Fees may vary by program and semester.
For UOS admissions, eligibility criteria, application deadlines, and merit lists, please consult the official University of Sargodha admissions portal. Requirements and deadlines can vary by program.
University and department office timings may vary by campus, department, and day. Please confirm the current schedule with your department or the relevant UOS office.

For UOS library membership, book borrowing, return policies, and opening hours, please contact the university library or check its official information. Keep your student ID available when asking about membership.

For UOS hostel accommodation, room availability, hostel fees, and allotment procedures, please contact the university hostel administration. Availability and eligibility may depend on university policy.
